discoveryNotes: Pinball Brothers game pages embed per-game PDF rulesheets in nectar_btn shortcode url= attributes within content.rendered. ABBA Pinball has ABBA_Quick_Rule_Sheet.pdf (confirmed rulesheet; link text 'Rulesheet', URL path /games/abba/documents/). robots.txt: Disallow /wp-admin/ only; no Crawl-delay; no restrictions on /games/ or /wp-json/. PbGamePageDocumentScraper extracts from WP REST pages?_fields=…,content. Predator/Queen/Alien pages have no documents as of 2026-06-25.

No service bulletin section on jerseyjackpinball.com. Per-game support pages at /pages/support/{slug} contain manuals, code updates, ISOs, and rules — but no bulletin-class documents. robots.txt (Shopify) has no path restrictions on support content.

Service bulletins published at american-pinball.com/support/ — single static HTML page with anchor-tab layout per game (Houdini, Oktoberfest, Hot Wheels, Galactic Tank Force, Legends of Valhalla, Barry O's BBQ Challenge). Bulletin PDFs hosted on CDN subdomain s4.american-pinball.com under /img/support/YYYY-M/{filename}.pdf. No robots.txt restrictions found. ApBulletinScraper wired.

No service bulletin document type on spookypinball.com. /game-support/ hub has per-game pages with manuals, switch/coil charts, rules PDFs, and code update packages — but no distinct bulletin/advisory category. robots.txt specifies 10-second crawl-delay; no path restrictions on support content.

chicago-gaming.com/product/bulletins/ exists but contains only arcade product bulletins (Arcade Legends, Golden Tee). Pinball titles (Attack From Mars, Medieval Madness, Monster Bash, Pulp Fiction, Cactus Canyon) are not covered. Pinball support routed via Freshdesk; /coinop/{slug}/update pages list code updates only.

Service bulletins exist at pinballbrothers.freshdesk.com/support/solutions (General > Service Bulletins folder, 4 confirmed notices). Freshdesk REST API available at {subdomain}.freshdesk.com/api/v2/solutions/folders/{id}/articles returns JSON but requires API key even for public portals. Deferred pending API key acquisition.

Kineticist founder Colin Alsheimer granted explicit written permission (ADR-0043 / PR #520) to index published gameplay tutorials. Appending .md to any article URL returns clean Markdown with title, author, date, category, and canonical URL inline. Category listing at /news/category/pinball-tutorial. robots.txt ai-train=yes, ai-input=yes; /news/ allowed for all crawlers including ClaudeBot. ~50 tutorials across 2 pages as of 2026-06-25. Ingested via --sync-kineticist-tutorials CLI verb (synthesis path, not change-feed).

Colin Alsheimer / Kineticist granted explicit permission to index TWIP newsletter content per ADR-0043 (June 2026). robots.txt (verified 2026-06-26) allows all crawlers on /p/* paths. No API key required — content is publicly accessible.

HTTP 403 Forbidden on all programmatic fetch attempts; robots.txt review pending. IPDB is registered as a link-to community resource (community_resources.v1.json) — the machine page URL pattern https://www.ipdb.org/machine.cgi?id={ipdb_id} is used as a provenance reference on Machine records (via ipdbReferenceUrl field) but no content is ingested. Terms of service review required before any scraping can be considered.

ADR-0043 grants permission to index kineticist.com published tutorials and TWIP content. The /downloads/ section hosts an indexed library of Williams (231+ files), Bally (217+ files), and Data East (50+ files) manuals with download links. A free kineticist.com account is required to download; the listing page itself may be publicly accessible. Deferred pending explicit confirmation from Colin Alsheimer that ADR-0043 scope extends to the downloads section (tutorials-only vs. whole-site). High value for Williams/Bally legacy manual gap-fill once confirmed.

The Pinball Resource is the licensed rights holder for Gottlieb factory documentation. Their manuals section at pbresource.com/manuals.html is the canonical source for Gottlieb SS-era manuals. Content is commercially licensed — scraping is not permitted. Link-to posture only: cite pbresource.com/manuals.html as the reference for any Gottlieb manual question. Note: IPDB often enforces Gottlieb copyright more aggressively than for Williams/Bally — direct IPDB documentation links for Gottlieb games are frequently unavailable or broken.

Planetary Pinball holds Williams/Bally/Midway IP for parts and documentation reprints. Their catalog includes Color Master Catalogs, game manuals with schematics (Bally 1969–1980, Williams 1966–1995), and parts catalogs. Commercial licensing — link-to only; no scraping permitted. Used as a reference citation for Williams/Bally era documentation questions alongside IPDB.

The Internet Archive hosts community-uploaded pinball manual scans across all manufacturers. Content is CC-licensed or public domain where donated. Technically scrapeable (robots.txt allows; no rate-limiting beyond politeness). Deferred because: (1) ROI is lower than manufacturer-direct sources which have already run, (2) scan quality and accuracy is unverified — many community uploads are incomplete or incorrectly labeled, (3) best used for gap-fill only (Gottlieb, Capcom, Zaccaria, defunct manufacturers) rather than as a primary source. Revisit when Gottlieb gap-fill is prioritized. Search pattern: https://archive.org/search?query=pinball+manual+{manufacturer}
